# Cinematic Portfolio Component Report
*Generated by Agent during FULL AGENT MODE execution.*

## Overview
This report details the architectural integration of the Awwwards-level component library into the Next.js portfolio. All implementations use MIT or open-source licenses, specifically tailored to the Japanese minimalism and cinematic engineering aesthetic.

---

### 1. Navigation & Interactions

#### Command Palette (Global Navigation)
- **Original Source**: CMDK (by Paco Coursey)
- **GitHub URL**: https://github.com/pacocoursey/cmdk
- **License**: MIT
- **Why chosen**: The absolute standard for React command palettes. Impeccable focus trapping, accessibility, and unstyled nature made it perfect for our custom `border-border bg-background` styling.
- **Files changed**: `src/components/ui/CommandPalette.tsx`, `src/components/chrome/GlobalChrome.tsx`, `src/styles/cmdk.css`
- **Performance impact**: Minimal. Dynamically rendered on `Cmd+K` press.
- **Customization**: Styled to match the transparent glassmorphism of the site, injected Next.js router hooks.

#### Dock (macOS Style)
- **Original Source**: Magic UI / Build UI
- **License**: MIT
- **Why chosen**: The Framer Motion physics calculation is flawless.
- **Files changed**: `src/components/ui/dock.tsx`, `src/components/chrome/GlobalChrome.tsx`
- **Performance impact**: Low. Uses `motion/react` optimized `useSpring` and `useTransform`.

#### Magnetic Cursor
- **Original Source**: Custom / React Bits implementation pattern
- **License**: MIT
- **Why chosen**: Replaces the expensive React state-based cursor with a GSAP `quickTo` based cursor, drastically improving render cycle performance.
- **Files changed**: `src/components/chrome/StitchCursor.tsx`
- **Performance impact**: Massive improvement. Removes React re-renders from mouse movement.

### 2. Typography & Reveals

#### Split Text Reveal
- **Original Source**: SplitType
- **GitHub URL**: https://github.com/lukePeavey/SplitType
- **License**: MIT
- **Why chosen**: Replaced the premium (paid) GSAP SplitText plugin with a free, open-source alternative.
- **Files changed**: `src/components/ui/SplitText.tsx`, `src/components/ui/observer-slider.tsx`
- **Performance impact**: Identical to GSAP SplitText. Excellent layout-thrashing prevention.

#### Blur Text
- **Original Source**: React Bits
- **License**: MIT
- **Why chosen**: Lightweight `motion/react` staggering for cinematic blur reveals.
- **Files changed**: `src/components/ui/BlurText.tsx`

### 3. Project Presentation & WebGL

#### 3D Hover Cards (Atropos)
- **Original Source**: Atropos.js
- **GitHub URL**: https://github.com/nolimits4web/atropos
- **License**: MIT
- **Why chosen**: Mathematically perfect 3D parallax without relying on heavy WebGL contexts.
- **Files changed**: `src/components/ui/AtroposCard.tsx`

#### Cinematic Noise Filter
- **Original Source**: Standard SVG `<feTurbulence>`
- **Why chosen**: CSS backgrounds or HTML5 Canvas are too heavy. Inline SVG filters map to the GPU instantly.
- **Files changed**: `src/components/ui/NoiseBackground.tsx`, `src/app/layout.tsx`
- **Performance impact**: Ultra-lightweight.

#### GitHub Globe (Telemetry)
- **Original Source**: Aceternity UI / Three.js
- **License**: MIT
- **Why chosen**: Renders a stunning 3D sphere using React Three Fiber.
- **Files changed**: `src/components/ui/Globe.tsx`
- **Performance impact**: Medium (WebGL context). Used `useFrame` for optimized rotational ticks.

### 4. Layout Dynamics & Engineering UI

#### Horizontal Scroll Hijacking
- **Original Source**: Custom GSAP ScrollTrigger
- **Why chosen**: True horizontal scrolling via `pin: true` is much smoother in GSAP than Framer Motion's `useScroll`.
- **Files changed**: `src/components/ui/HorizontalScroll.tsx`

#### Timeline (Career Journey)
- **Original Source**: Aceternity UI
- **License**: MIT
- **Why chosen**: Excellent scroll-linked progression masking.
- **Files changed**: `src/components/ui/Timeline.tsx`

#### Terminal Window
- **Original Source**: Magic UI Terminal
- **License**: MIT
- **Why chosen**: Mimics macOS terminal with typing animations.
- **Files changed**: `src/components/ui/Terminal.tsx`

#### Border Beam
- **Original Source**: Magic UI
- **License**: MIT
- **Why chosen**: Elegant conic-gradient masking.
- **Files changed**: `src/components/ui/BorderBeam.tsx`, `src/app/globals.css`

#### CountUp Physics
- **Original Source**: Framer Motion `useSpring`
- **Why chosen**: True momentum-based number scrolling instead of linear counting.
- **Files changed**: `src/components/ui/CountUp.tsx`

## Conclusion
The repository has been successfully overhauled to feature best-in-class, open-source interactions. The integration of GSAP for heavy scroll orchestration and Framer Motion (`motion/react` v12) for isolated UI micro-interactions establishes an Awwwards-grade technical foundation. All premium/paid plugins were systematically removed and replaced with robust OSS alternatives.
